title: Efficient Planning in a Compact Latent Action Space (Trajectory Autoencoding Planner, TAP)

methods.one_paragraph_description: Learns discrete latent action codes with a state-conditional VQ-VAE over trajectories (each latent code covers L=3 raw steps, K=512 codebook entries); the causal-Transformer decoder acts as a dynamics model mapping (initial state, latent codes) to a trajectory of states, actions, rewards and returns-to-go, and a Transformer prior p(z|s) models latent sequences. At decision time TAP runs beam search in the latent space (beam width B, expansion factor E), scoring trajectories by predicted discounted return plus an OOD penalty alpha*ln min(p(z|s), beta^M), and executes the first action of the best plan.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: model-based planning / sequence modelling (paper: 'TAP is a novel model-based RL method'; 'conceptually the most related to the Trajectory Transformer'; 'Planning-based reinforcement learning')
